selection_rule_source: v22 MINIMAL_DISCRIMINATING_EXPERIMENTS.md; materialized in E1 v23 and reused without resampling
dataset_split: train only; WT2 test and C4 evaluation splits were not loaded
parser: v14/v15 full article parser; heading regex ^=[space][^=].*[space]=$ and semicolon headings excluded

split_rule.semantics: whole documents; no document or token fragments shared between search and held

derived_from_manifest.reuse_semantics: same 64 complete articles, token sequences, ordering and S0/S1 search/held split from the v22 frozen selection rule

held_use: held samples are scored only after search selections are locked; no held labels enter region, grid or alpha selection
